publication_gate: No changed research claim, case-study fact, freshness date, or public-facing annual statistic should be published until the source data has been cleaned and validated. If the review finds meaningful surprises, brief Crystal before publishing those changed claims.
live_data_note: Restaurant searches query NYC Open Data live. The annual review refreshes research snapshots, case-study facts, violation summaries, official grading/status rules, and visible freshness dates.
annual_review_scope: Pull fresh official NYC DOHMH restaurant-inspection data
Clean the data first: normalize text, validate required values, validate dates and scores, remove exact duplicates, and document anything removed
Validate source schema, action labels, critical-flag values, missingness, and unexpected data-quality changes
Recompute the score-50 initial-inspection counts with Python
Recompute the 41-60 point selected-violation comparison with Python
Compare the new clean results with the previously published research baseline
Flag meaningful changes or unexpected patterns as surprises
Brief Crystal about surprises before publishing changed claims
Recheck official NYC restaurant grading and inspection-process rules
Recheck Don Alex and La Dinastia case-study records and current-status claims before publishing them as current facts
Review plain-language violation mappings for wording or schema changes
Update the City Bites README, annual research snapshot, and visible freshness dates only after review
Commit approved changes to GitHub main and verify the Vercel production deployment
